hints.loyaltyFreeEvery: N ≥ 2. With N = 10 the 10th wash is free after 9 paid ones. Only completed orders count.
hints.loyaltyFreeScope: Base wash: the base-wash line becomes free, add-ons stay paid.
hints.loyaltyFreeMinPrice: A cheaper wash neither counts nor can be the free one. 0 = all count.
hints.loyaltyEarnPerEur: Points are credited when an order is completed, on what was actually paid (after discounts and points). 1 = one point per euro. 0 switches points and the referral reward off.
hints.loyaltyPointValueEur: What one point is worth when spent. 0.01 = 100 points are 1 EUR.
hints.loyaltyRedeemMinPoints: A request below this is refused. 0 = any amount.
hints.loyaltyRedeemMaxPercent: Counted on the total that remains after a promo code or free wash. 50 = at most half of the order.
hints.loyaltyEarnOnPromo: Off: an order that used a promo code earns no points.
hints.loyaltyPointsExpireDays: Applies to points credited from now on. The daily job writes expired points off.
hints.loyaltyReferrerPoints: Paid to the customer whose code was used, once the new customer's first order is completed.
hints.loyaltyReferredPoints: Paid to the new customer at the same moment.
hints.loyaltyReferralMinAmountEur: The first completed order must have been paid at least this much. Below it, no reward.
hints.loyaltyReferralHoldDays: With a number above 0 the reward waits; the daily job pays it. If the order is cancelled or re-opened meanwhile, no reward.
hints.loyaltyReferralMaxPerMonth: Stops one customer from collecting rewards without limit. Counted per referrer over a rolling 30 days.
